title: Worker direct line
blurb: Transfers one end of a MessageChannel through audioWorklet.port to AudioWorkletGlobalScope and the other to a Worker so the worker synthesizes an additive wavetable and transfers the Float32Array directly to the audio thread.
question: Can a MessageChannel transferred via audioWorklet.port let a dedicated Worker stream zero-copy Float32Array wavetables directly into AudioWorkletGlobalScope without routing sample buffers through the main thread?
result: On Chrome for Testing 153 using the labelled bootstrap fallback for the initial port handoff, the worker-built 2048-sample wavetable transferred directly to the audio thread with matching checksums, detached sender buffer (byteLength 0), and matching rendered waveform peak. Spec-path handoff over audioWorklet.port not verified in Chrome 160.
testedIn: Chrome for Testing 153 (worker-to-worklet transfer verified via bootstrap fallback); not verified in Chrome 160
